Description: Warms 1 cubic foot of stone per level up to 100˚F at a rate of 1 cu' per round of concentration (without concentration, the material will remain at its current temperature for the remainder of the duration)
As Warm Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal per level can be warmed each round
As Warm Stone, except can affect any solid, inanimate, non-metal material

As Warm Stone except temperature limit is 500˚F. In addition, caster must concentrate for 1 round to raise the temperature 50˚F (up to the maximum). Caster need only touch the target when the spell is cast
As Heat Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal per level can be heated
As Heat Stone, except affects any solid, inanimate, non-metal material
As Warm Stone, except chills any solid, inanimate material down to 0˚F
As Heat Stone, except temperature can be lower to -200˚F at a rate of 100˚F per round
Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' section will extend to their limit

As Heat Solid, except the only limit to the temperature is the melting point of the solid (i.e., until the solid melts). Will affect 6 cubic inches of metal or 1 cubic foot of any other material. See Section 7.1.13 for some sample melting points
As Cracks Call, except material with cracks will crumble to dust
Will break a piece of wood up to 1' in diameter
Creates 3'x6'x1' doorway through stone
As Stone Door, except doorway can be through metal
As Bowbreak, except a piece of metal can be broken. Will affect metals up to 3" in diameter
Causes a lock to break. The lock can be broken in a locked or unlocked state (regardless of its state at the time the spell is cast)
As Stone Door, except doorway can be in any inanimate, solid material and it can be 3'x6' with a depth of 1' per level (for stone) or 3" per level (for all other materials)
By molding with his hands, caster may shape 1 cubic foot of stone as if it were putty or clay. At the end of the spell's duration, the stone will harden to normal consistency
As Mold Stone, except caster may mold metal
As Mold Stone, except caster may mold any inanimate, solid material

May transmute 1 oz. of solid material into another non-magical material (the caster must have a sample of the material available). This spell takes 8 hours of continous, uninterrupted concentration. SPECIAL NOTES See Section 7.1.13 for notes on construction and destruction of solid materials, including sample melting points. CLOSED MENTALISM 4.2.8 SOLID MANIPULATION
